name: Stochastic-gated BN $\,/\,$GN blend
tagline: Per-channel sigmoid gate blends affine-free BN and GN, with Gaussian noise injected into the gate logits at training time.

key_hyperparams.name: $\sigma_n$
key_hyperparams.role: Gaussian-noise std on gate logits at train

diff_from_baseline: Like Batch-Instance Norm but mixes BN with GN(8) instead of IN, removes affine from each branch, and adds Gaussian noise on the gate logit during training as implicit regularization.

name: GN + per-channel SE-style scale
tagline: GroupNorm followed by a per-channel multiplicative scale $1+\tfrac12\tanh(\cdot)$ driven by per-instance mean absolute activation.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a small per-instance, per-channel SE-style scale modulator on top of GroupNorm; the modulator is a tanh of a learned linear projection of $\overline{|x_{:,c,:,:}|}_{HW}$, bounded in $[\tfrac12, \tfrac32]$.

name: LayerNorm-then-BatchNorm
tagline: Pre-normalize each sample to zero mean / unit variance over (C,H,W), then apply standard BatchNorm.
diff_from_baseline: Pre-pends a non-affine LayerNorm-over-CHW (instance-level energy decoupling) before standard BatchNorm; no learnable mixing weights.

name: Reliability-gated BN $\,/\,$(GN+LN)
tagline: Per-channel gate shrinks toward BN moments when local (GN+LN) moments agree with running batch statistics, away when they don't.
formula: $$ \mu_{loc} = a\,\mu_g + (1-a)\,\mu_\ell, \qquad q_{loc} = a\,q_g + (1-a)\,q_\ell, \quad a = \sigma(\alpha) $$ $$ d = \frac{(\mu_{loc} - \mu_b)^2}{v_b + \epsilon} + \big|\log(v_{loc}+\epsilon) - \log(v_b+\epsilon)\big|,\quad g = \sigma\!\big(b_g - s_g^2\, d\big) $$ $$ \mu = g\,\mu_b + (1-g)\,\mu_{loc}, \quad v = g\,q_b + (1-g)\,q_{loc} - \mu^2,\quad y = \gamma\frac{x-\mu}{\sqrt{v+\epsilon}}+\beta $$
init_recovers: Pure BatchNorm when $g\to1$ ($d=0$); pure GN+LN mix when $g\to0$
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes Switchable Norm: builds a sample-local moment from a learned GN/LN mix and gates it against running BN moments using a KL-like discrepancy $d$ that grows when local stats disagree with the batch.

name: Per-channel BN/GN moment blend
tagline: Per-channel learnable sigmoid gate convexly mixes BN moments (running at eval) with GN moments before normalization.
diff_from_baseline: Like Switchable Norm but only mixes BN and GN, the mixing weight is per-channel (not per-norm), the BN branch uses running stats at eval to avoid train/test drift, and the GN/BN moments themselves (not the normalized outputs) are blended.
